grid.expression: SELECT PAR.CODPARC, UPPER(PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, PAR.TELEFONE, PAR.CGC_CPF, PAR.CODCID, UPPER(CID.NOMECID) AS NOMECID, PAR.CEP, PAR.CODEND, UPPER(concatStr((concatStr(trim(EDR.TIPO) , ' ')), trim(EDR.NOMEEND))) AS NOMEEND, UPPER(UFS.DESCRICAO) AS DESCRICAO, (SELECT VEN.APELIDO FROM TGFVEN VEN WHERE PAR.CODVEND = VEN.CODVEND) AS CODVEND, (SELECT MAX(TRUNC(C.DTNEG)) FROM TGFCAB C WHERE C.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC) AS ULTIMACOMPRA FROM TGFPAR PAR INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON PAR.CODCID = CID.CODCID --INNER JOIN TSICEP CEP ON PAR.CEP = CEP.CEP INNER JOIN TSIEND EDR ON PAR.CODEND = EDR.CODEND INNER JOIN TSIUFS UFS ON CID.UF = UFS.CODUF WHERE PAR.ATIVO = 'S' AND PAR.CODPARC IN (SELECT DISTINCT CAB.CODPARC FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD WHERE CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND (:P_CODPROD IS NULL OR ITE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD) AND PRO.USOPROD = 'V' AND CAB.DTNEG >= (ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-12))) AND (:P_CODUF IS NULL OR UFS.CODUF = :P_CODUF) AND (:P_CODCID IS NULL OR PAR.CODCID = :P_CODCID) AND PAR.TIPPESSOA = 'J' AND PAR.CODPARC NOT IN (3,492) ORDER BY PAR.CODPARC

SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.QTDNEG FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD WHERE CAB.CODPARC = :A_CODPARC AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND CAB.DTNEG >= (ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-12)) AND PRO.USOPROD = 'V'
